central_theme: Grassroots justice, moral integrity, wisdom over greed, and community ethics

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Traditional Indian village governance delivering fair, clever, and impartial justice.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Deceit and greed eventually backfire when confronted by wise, unbiased leadership.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Stand up against exploitation; integrity and truth always triumph.

child_nodes.title: The Conflict
child_nodes.details: A farmer buys a well, but the deceitful seller demands extra payment for water.

child_nodes.title: The Appeal
child_nodes.details: The aggrieved farmer seeks justice from the village Panchayat council.

child_nodes.title: The Wise Ruling
child_nodes.details: The Chief rules: if water belongs to seller, seller must pay rent for storing it in farmer's well!

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: The deceitful seller apologizes, relinquishes claim, and justice is served.

child_nodes.title: The Honest Farmer
child_nodes.details: Hardworking, humble, and trusting man who relies on village council justice.

child_nodes.title: The Deceitful Seller
child_nodes.details: Greedy neighbor who tries to exploit wordings to cheat his buyer.

child_nodes.title: Panchayat Chief
child_nodes.details: Wise, sharp-witted elder who outsmarts the cheat with brilliant logic.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Panchayat, dispute, deceitful, verdict, relinquish, outwitted, irrigate.

child_nodes.title: Conditional Clauses
child_nodes.details: If-then logic ('If you own the water, then pay rent for the well storage').

child_nodes.title: Moral Inspiration
child_nodes.details: Biographical link to Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa on truth and unity.
